cards.name: Amazon Pay
cards.welcome_benefit: Prime membership / Amazon vouchers for new customers (offer varies); cashback credited as Amazon Pay balance monthly
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver (historically; fuel earns no cashback)
cards.reward_exclusions: Since 11 Oct 2025: on Amazon - no cashback on gold coins, EMI, rent, tax, education; outside Amazon - no cashback on EMI, rent, fuel, tax, education, utilities and international transactions. Utility/insurance payments earn 2% only when made via Amazon app/site.
cards.eligibility: Standard ICICI credit card eligibility; instant approval for existing ICICI customers
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Cashback modeled as points with 1 unit = Re.1 (credited as Amazon Pay balance). Devalued 11 Oct 2025 (category exclusions above). From 15 Jan 2026 ICICI levies 1% fee on wallet loads >= Rs.5,000/month, 2% on online gaming, 1% on utility spends > Rs.50,000/month - these apply bank-wide including this card. 5%/3% Amazon cashback remains uncapped.

cards.name: Platinum Chip
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL pumps on transactions up to Rs.4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn reduced 1 point per Rs.100
cards.notes: Lifetime free basic card. 1 RP = Rs.0.25 on vouchers/catalogue; Rs.99 + GST redemption handling fee per request. Post Nov-2024 monthly earn caps on grocery (Rs.20,000 spend) and utility+insurance (Rs.40,000 spend) apply as on other non-premium ICICI cards.

cards.name: Coral
cards.variant: RuPay variant supports UPI; terms broadly identical
cards.milestone_benefits: 2,000 RP on Rs.2 lakh annual spend, then 1,000 RP per additional Rs.1 lakh (max 10,000 RP/year). Rent, government and education spends excluded from milestones and fee waiver since Nov 2024.
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic lounge visit per quarter, only if Rs.75,000+ spent in previous calendar quarter; 4 railway lounge visits/year
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL on transactions of Rs.400-4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100
cards.notes: Post Nov-2024: points on grocery spends capped at Rs.20,000/month and on utility+insurance at Rs.40,000/month; from Feb 2026 transport (train/bus) rewards capped at Rs.10,000/month. 25% off up to Rs.100 on BookMyShow/INOX twice a month requires Rs.25,000 spend in previous quarter (ICICI trimming BMS benefits from Feb 2026 on select cards).

cards.name: Expressions
cards.variant: Personalised card design (175+ designs or own photo)
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access gated on Rs.75,000 spend in previous calendar quarter
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL on transactions up to Rs.4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities earn reduced rate (~2 RP per Rs.100 per aggregators)
cards.notes: Essentially a Coral-tier card with custom design. Aggregators (CardInsider, BankBazaar) list 3 RP per Rs.100 non-fuel with 1 RP = Rs.0.25; ICICI's own page is vague on earn rate - verify before relying on the 3x figure. Movie benefit: Rs.100 off 2 tickets on BookMyShow/INOX twice a month.

cards.name: Rubyx
cards.variant: Dual-card setup historically (MC + Amex); Amex cashback offers revoked Jan 2025
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome vouchers (Tata CLiQ, EaseMyTrip, Croma, EazyDiner, Avis) on joining-fee payment
cards.milestone_benefits: 3,000 RP on Rs.3 lakh spend + 1,500 RP per additional Rs.1 lakh, up to 15,000 RP/year. Rent/govt/education spends excluded from milestones and fee waiver.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter); 2 railway lounge visits/quarter
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL on transactions of Rs.400-4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100
cards.notes: Post Nov-2024: utility+insurance earning capped at Rs.80,000/month spend and grocery at Rs.40,000/month (Rubyx-and-above tier); from Feb 2026 transport rewards capped at Rs.20,000/month. Golf: 1 round per Rs.50,000 monthly retail spend (max 2/month). Movies: 25% off up to Rs.150 on BookMyShow/INOX twice a month (Rs.25,000 quarterly-spend gate).

cards.name: Sapphiro
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome vouchers worth ~Rs.8,000: Rs.3,000 Tata CLiQ, 4x Rs.1,000 EaseMyTrip, 4x Rs.250 Uber, Rs.1,000 Croma
cards.milestone_benefits: 4,000 RP on Rs.4 lakh spend + 2,000 RP per additional Rs.1 lakh, up to 20,000 RP/year. Rent/govt/education excluded from milestones and fee waiver.
cards.lounge_access: 4 domestic lounge visits/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter); 2 international lounge visits/year via DreamFolks
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL on transactions of Rs.400-4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100
cards.notes: Post Nov-2024 premium-tier caps: utility+insurance earning up to Rs.80,000/month spend, grocery Rs.40,000/month; transport rewards capped Rs.20,000/month from Feb 2026. Golf: up to 4 rounds/lessons per month (Rs.50,000 prior-month spend). BOGO movie up to Rs.500 off second ticket twice a month (Rs.25,000 quarterly gate).

cards.name: Emeralde
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.5,000 Tata CLiQ voucher annually (Amex variant)
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic and international (Priority Pass) lounge access; exempt from the Rs.75,000 quarterly-spend gate
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100
cards.eligibility: Salaried Rs.1.5 lakh+/month or self-employed Rs.18 lakh+ ITR; age 21-65
cards.notes: Legacy plastic super-premium card, still listed with an apply option but largely superseded by Emeralde Private Metal. 1 RP = Rs.0.25. Up to 4 golf rounds/month on eligible spend; BOGO movies up to 4x/month (Rs.25,000 quarterly gate). Rs.3 crore air-accident cover. Cancellation cover up to Rs.12,000. Premium-tier category caps (utility+insurance Rs.80,000/month, grocery Rs.40,000/month) apply post Nov-2024.

cards.name: Emeralde Private Metal
cards.welcome_benefit: 12,500 RP on joining-fee payment + Taj Epicure Plus membership + EazyDiner Prime membership
cards.milestone_benefits: EaseMyTrip air travel vouchers of Rs.3,000 each at Rs.4 lakh and Rs.8 lakh annual spend (verify current milestone terms; rent/govt/education excluded)
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited international lounge access for primary and add-on cardholders; unlimited domestic lounge access; exempt from spend gate
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, EMI earn no points. Category earn caps per statement cycle: grocery/utilities/education 1,000 RP each; insurance 5,000 RP.
cards.eligibility: Invite-led in practice (via Relationship Manager); age 21-65
cards.notes: Earns 6 RP per Rs.200 (= 3 per Rs.100). 1 RP = up to Re.1 when redeemed for flights/hotels via iShop (best case, used here); ~Rs.0.40 as statement credit - blended value depends on redemption. Unlimited golf rounds. BOGO movie up to Rs.750 twice a month via BookMyShow (BMS benefits being trimmed from Feb 2026 - verify). Rs.3 crore air-accident cover.

cards.name: Times Black
cards.variant: Visa Infinite metal card, co-brand with Times Internet
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.10,000 EaseMyTrip voucher, luxury-stay gift card (~Rs.10-12k), Zomato Gold membership, Toni & Guy Rs.3,000 card, Interflora Rs.1,000 voucher, visa doorstep service (year 1)
cards.milestone_benefits: Rs.2L: Rs.10k Klook voucher; Rs.5L: 2 premium-sedan airport transfers or 1 helicopter transfer (Bengaluru); Rs.10L: Rs.10k Tata CLiQ Luxury voucher; Rs.20L: complimentary resort night (~Rs.20k value)
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic lounge access; unlimited international lounge access via Priority Pass (no guest visits)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver; fuel earns no points
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel and rent earn nothing. Utilities, insurance, education and government payments earn but capped at 5,000 RP per statement cycle (combined categories).
cards.eligibility: Salaried Rs.2 lakh+/month or self-employed Rs.24 lakh+ annual income; age 21+
cards.notes: Launched Dec 2024. 1 RP = up to Re.1 on products/vouchers/travel via redemption portal (used here); Rs.0.40 as statement credit. Effective 2% domestic / 2.5% international / 6% flights-hotels. High Rs.25L fee-waiver threshold. Bank-wide Jan-2026 fees (gaming 2%, wallet load 1%, etc.) apply.

cards.name: MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank
cards.variant: Both Mastercard and RuPay cards issued together; RuPay supports UPI
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.1,000 MakeMyTrip voucher on joining fee (and Rs.1,000 hotel voucher on renewal fee); complimentary MMTBLACK Gold for 1 year
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter); 1 international lounge visit/year
cards.reward_exclusions: No myCash on rent, cash advances, fees/charges, EMIs, balance transfer, personal loans; fuel excluded
cards.notes: 2025 relaunch replacing older MMT ICICI Signature/Platinum cards (those are closed to new applicants). 1 myCash = Re.1, redeemable only on MakeMyTrip; myCash never expires and earning is unlimited. Effective 6%/3%/1% return for MMT-heavy users. Standout 0.99% forex markup.

cards.name: HPCL Super Saver

merchant_bonuses.merchant: HPCL fuel (4% cashback, modeled as point-equivalent)

cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 RP on first spend within 30/45 days (offer-dependent; verify)
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic lounge visit/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL (part of the 5% total fuel saving)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel spends earn cashback not points; standard ICICI exclusions (rent, EMI, etc.)
cards.notes: Fuel: 4% cashback at HPCL capped Rs.200/month + 1% surcharge waiver = ~5%; extra 1.5% Happy Coins when paying via HP Pay app. Bonus categories: 20 RP per Rs.100 (=5% at Rs.0.25/RP) on utilities, groceries, department stores, capped at 400 RP/month per category. Base: 2 RP per Rs.100 (0.5%). From Feb 2026 insurance rewards capped at Rs.40,000/month spend. Mixed reward currencies - fuel cashback modeled as point-equivalents at rupee_per_point 0.25 (16 per 100 = 4%).

cards.name: HPCL Coral

merchant_bonuses.merchant: HPCL fuel (2.5% cashback, modeled as point-equivalent)

cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL (total ~3.5% fuel saving with 2.5% cashback)
cards.reward_exclusions: Utilities/insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100; standard exclusions
cards.notes: Older low-fee fuel card, still open per bank page. 2.5% fuel cashback (monthly cap applies - historically Rs.100/month, verify) + 1% surcharge waiver. 25% BookMyShow discount and Culinary Treats dining offers.

cards.name: Adani One Signature
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.5,000 flight vouchers on Rs.25,000 spend within 60 days; 2 Pranaam airport meet-&-greet services/year; 2 premium car parking on activation
cards.milestone_benefits: Second Pranaam service after Rs.3 lakh spend; porter services 2 per Rs.1 lakh spent (max 8/year); 4 valet parking/year
cards.lounge_access: 4 domestic lounge visits/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter); 2 international lounge visits/year via Priority Pass
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard ICICI exclusions (fuel points, rent, EMI); Adani points usable only within Adani One app ecosystem
cards.notes: Adani points credited to Adani OneApp after statement cycle; 1 point = Re.1 within Adani ecosystem only (redemption utility is the main caveat). Effective 7% on Adani One bookings. Amex variant cashback offers revoked Jan 2025.

cards.name: Adani One Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.2,000 flight vouchers on Rs.10,000 spend within 60 days; 2 premium car parking on activation
cards.milestone_benefits: Porter services up to 4/year (per Rs.1 lakh spent); 2 valet parking/year; 8 premium lounge upgrades/year
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits/quarter (requires Rs.75,000 spend in previous quarter)
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard ICICI exclusions; Adani points usable only within Adani One ecosystem
cards.notes: 1 Adani point = Re.1 within Adani One app. 3% back on Adani ecosystem, 1% elsewhere. 25% off BookMyShow up to Rs.100 (Rs.25,000 quarterly gate).

cards.name: Emirates Skywards Emeralde
cards.welcome_benefit: 10,000 bonus Skywards Miles + Emirates Skywards Gold tier on fee payment (tier benefits per launch terms)
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited/premium lounge access per launch terms (verify for existing holders)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, EMI and standard ICICI exclusions
cards.notes: Launched 2022; ICICI stopped NEW applications for all Emirates Skywards co-brands around June 2025 - existing holders retained. Earned 2.5 Skywards Miles per Rs.100. rupee_per_point null: Skywards mile value varies (~Rs.1-1.5 typical on Emirates redemptions).

cards.name: Emirates Skywards Sapphiro
cards.welcome_benefit: 5,000 bonus Skywards Miles + Skywards Silver tier on fee payment
cards.lounge_access: Domestic + limited international lounge access per launch terms
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, EMI and standard ICICI exclusions
cards.notes: New applications stopped ~June 2025; existing holders retained. Earned 2 Skywards Miles per Rs.100. Mile value varies (~Rs.1-1.5).

cards.name: Emirates Skywards Rubyx
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,500 bonus Skywards Miles (verify) on fee payment
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access per launch terms (Rs.75,000 quarterly gate applies)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, EMI and standard ICICI exclusions
cards.notes: New applications stopped ~June 2025; existing holders retained. Earned 1.5 Skywards Miles per Rs.100. Mile value varies (~Rs.1-1.5).

cards.name: Manchester United (Platinum/Signature)
cards.notes: Football-fan co-brand, long discontinued for new applications (partnership lapsed). Some legacy holders remain; ICICI's Feb-2026 reward-cap circulars still reference the card for existing holders (transport cap Rs.10,000/month tier). Not comparable for new applicants.

cards.name: InterMiles (Coral/Rubyx/Sapphiro)
cards.notes: Discontinued: the InterMiles loyalty programme (ex-JetPrivilege) wound down and ICICI migrated holders to the equivalent core cards (Coral/Rubyx/Sapphiro) around 2024. No new applications; miles earning ceased.

cards.name: Instant Platinum (FD-secured)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% at HPCL on transactions up to Rs.4,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel earns no points; utilities & insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100
cards.eligibility: Issued against ICICI fixed deposit (min ~Rs.50,000); no income proof needed
cards.notes: Lifetime free secured card for credit-builders. From Feb 2026 loses BookMyShow movie benefit entirely.
